caption: Florence Cathedral (Duomo), Florence
composition: Floodlit cathedral and campanile at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands in the empty Piazza del Duomo in the deep night, facing the floodlit cathedral from the southwest. Giotto's campanile rises at the left of the frame, Brunelleschi's great terracotta dome fills the center, and the marble-patterned flank of the nave runs to the right. Warm floodlighting picks out the green, white, and rose marble facing against the black sky of the modelled 23 September 2026, 04:57 scenario, while the surrounding palazzi glow softly and the paving stones mirror the light.
